rules.name: unclear notes go to a person

checks.text: The note gets the right failure mode from the fixed list.
The note goes to the team that owns the fix.
Every note about a person near the robot, an e-stop, or contact is flagged as safety.
Notes with no person, e-stop or contact are not flagged as safety.
A live cable disturbed, or the robot moving toward or touching a person, blocks unsupervised work.
Other notes do not block unsupervised work.
Unclear notes go to a person; clear notes do not.

The summary is one sentence that restates the tech note: what happened and, if the note says, what was done. It fails if it adds a cause, number, fix, actor or outcome that the note does not state or clearly imply, or if it contradicts the note. Plain paraphrase, expanding shorthand the note clearly means (a slot name such as C19 is the connection being made; the map is the customer's port map) and naming the rack are fine.
